note: Facts (timings, entry fees, founding dates, locations) extracted below; prose summaries are written in our own words, not copied verbatim from the source, out of copyright caution. Cross-check safety/official facts against puducherry-dt.gov.in and py.gov.in before publishing.

places.name: Paradise Beach (Plage Paradiso)
places.facts: Reached only by ferry from Chunnambar boat house through mangrove creeks; golden-sand isolated beach; birdwatching; water sports (canoeing, kayaking, jet-skiing); best Nov-Mar.

places.name: Sri Aurobindo Ashram
places.area: Rue de la Marine, White Town
places.facts: Founded 1926 by Sri Aurobindo Ghose; Samadhi of Sri Aurobindo and the Mother in the courtyard, decorated with fresh flowers daily; silence/no photography inside.

places.name: Auroville / Matrimandir
places.timings: 7:00 AM - 6:30 PM (township); Matrimandir viewing has separate, stricter hours and requires a pass from the Visitor Centre
places.entryFee: Free (township); Matrimandir inner chamber needs advance booking
places.facts: Founded 1968 by Mirra Alfassa ("The Mother"); experimental international township; Matrimandir is the golden geodesic meditation structure at its center.

places.name: Arikamedu
places.facts: Indo-Roman archaeological trading-port site, excavated from 1940s; ASI-protected; artifacts now held in Puducherry Museum.

places.name: Promenade Beach / Rock Beach (Seaside Promenade)
places.facts: 1.5km rocky, car-free waterfront promenade; French War Memorial, Dupleix statue and Gandhi statue along it; popular for evening walks.

places.name: Serenity Beach
places.facts: Known as a surfing beach with local surf schools; sunrise viewpoint.

places.name: Chunnambar Boat House
places.facts: Backwater boathouse; departure point for Paradise Beach ferry; houseboat and pedal-boat rides through mangrove creeks.

places.name: Botanical Garden
places.facts: Established 1826 by French botanist C.S. Perrottet; ~22 acres, ~1500 plant species; toy train, aquarium, musical fountain.

places.name: Old Lighthouse
places.timings: 3:00 PM - 7:00 PM (per source; verify locally, no longer operational as a navigation light)
places.facts: Built 1836 by French engineer L. Guerre, 29m tall; decommissioned when a new lighthouse opened at Kirapalayam in 1970.

places.name: Basilica of the Sacred Heart of Jesus
places.facts: Neo-Gothic church built 1908, raised to Basilica status in 2011; stained glass; one of India's minor basilicas.

places.name: Raj Niwas
places.timings: Exterior viewable; not open to public interior visits (per source: 9 AM-6 PM Mon-Sat, closed Sun, for exterior grounds — verify locally)
places.facts: Official residence of the Lieutenant Governor; originally built as the French Governor's palace, completed under Dupleix.

places.name: Jawahar Toy Museum
places.facts: ~140 dolls in regional Indian dress, run by Bal Bhavan.

places.name: French War Memorial
places.facts: Built 1937, inaugurated 1938; honors WWI soldiers; lit up on Bastille Day (14 July).

places.name: Sri Manakula Vinayagar Temple
places.area: Manakula Vinayagar Koil St, near Ashram
places.facts: ~500-year-old Ganesha temple; Dravidian-style gopuram; major Vinayaka Chaturthi celebrations.

places.name: Bharathi Park (Government Park)
places.timings: 6:00 AM - 7:00 PM (source states both 6:30AM-8:30PM and 6AM-7PM in different places; use 6AM-7PM, verify locally)
places.facts: Central park with the Aayi Mandapam (Greco-Roman style monument) at its center; surrounded by the old French colonial government buildings.

places.name: Immaculate Conception Cathedral
places.facts: Built 1791 in Portuguese style; seat of the Bishop of Puducherry; also called Notre Dame de la Conception Immaculée.

places.name: White Town (French Quarter)
places.area: Coastal quarter of the old city
places.facts: The old French residential quarter — colonial villas, French-named streets; contains the Ashram, Cathedral, museum and promenade.

places.name: Sri Karaneswara Nataraja Temple (Pyramid Temple)
places.timings: 6:00 AM - 12:00 PM, 4:00 PM - 9:00 PM (source also states 7-12, 4:15-7:15 — verify locally)
places.facts: Pyramid-shaped Shiva temple built 2000s (rebuilt after the original was destroyed in the 2004 tsunami).

places.name: Goubert Market (Grand Bazar)
places.facts: The city's main wholesale/retail market for produce, fish, flowers and handicrafts.

places.name: Sri Gokilambal Thirukameswarar Temple (Villianur temple)
places.facts: 12th-century Chola-era Shiva temple; annual Brahmotsavam chariot festival in May/June.

places.name: Ousteri Wetland and Bird Sanctuary
places.facts: ~500-year-old Vijayanagara-era reservoir/lake; recognized wetland for migratory birds; boating.

places.name: Veerampattinam Beach
places.facts: Long, relatively uncrowded beach; annual temple car festival in August.

places.name: Meeran Mosque (Meerapalli)
places.timings: 6:00 AM - 8:00 PM (grounds; not open to non-Muslims for prayer)
places.facts: ~350 years old, built by the Nawabs of Arcot; one of the oldest mosques in the region.

places.name: Kanniga Parameswari Temple
places.facts: Shakti temple blending Dravidian and European (French-influenced) architectural details.

places.name: Cluny Embroidery Centre
places.timings: 9:00 AM - 12:00 PM, 2:00 PM - 5:00 PM (closed Sat & Sun)
places.facts: Started 1829 by the Cluny order of nuns to train and employ underprivileged women in embroidery; still operating, sells handmade linens.

places.name: Pondicherry Museum (Government Museum)
places.timings: not stated in this source — verify before publishing
places.entryFee: not stated in this source — verify before publishing
places.facts: Holds Arikamedu excavation artifacts, French colonial-era furniture, and archaeological/geological collections. Mentioned across the source but without a dedicated timings/fee entry.

otherMentioned: Chidambaram Nataraja Temple (~58-65km away, in Tamil Nadu, not Puducherry UT)

howToReach.air: Puducherry Airport has limited domestic flights (Bengaluru/Hyderabad); Chennai International Airport (~135-150km) is the main gateway.
howToReach.rail: Villupuram Junction (~35km) is the nearest major station; Puducherry's own station has direct trains from Chennai and a few other cities.
howToReach.road: East Coast Road (ECR) from Chennai (~160km via ECR); regular buses/cabs from Chennai, Bengaluru (~310-320km), Tiruchirapalli (~200-220km).
